referenceUse: Style, palette, character identity and composition cues; original separately generated device compositions.

designs.name: Paimon Starlight
designs.brief: Small full-body Paimon with white bob, purple eyes, rose-gold halo and navy starry cape; expert anime stationery linework, warm ivory paper, blush and lilac watercolor corners, golden stars. Vast quiet timetable center. Mobile bottom right waving; tablet bottom left hands near chest; laptop bottom right holding golden star.

designs.name: Teyvat Sketch Parade
designs.brief: Handmade monochrome steel-blue pencil on warm ivory fibrous paper. Bottom parade of Venti, Zhongli, Aether, floating Paimon and friendly qilin, faint floating-island map corner. Mobile walking left; tablet Venti seated playing lyre, others walking right; laptop figures spread panoramically. Extensive blank middle.

constraints: Opaque full bleed artwork, correct complete anatomy, no text, schedule, UI, logos, watermark, frames or montage. Each format generated independently, then resized to exact required dimensions.
validation: Six PNG headers checked; exact device dimensions; RGB color type2 confirms opacity. All six visually inspected from generation results. Separate compositions retained during Lanczos size normalization.
